parsed_response.explanation: The orchestrator hallucinates the source of the information, claiming the U.S. Department of State - Office of the Historian confirms the year, when the WebSurfer's output clearly shows the information came from a Bing search result citing the U.S. Department of the Interior.
parsed_response.evidence: WebSurfer output: 'The U.S. Congress approved the Compact of Free Association with the Republic of the Marshall Islands in 1985. This approval was part of a broader agreement that also included the Federated States of Micronesia and the Republic of Palau. The Compact was signed into law on November 13, 1986. U.S. Department of the Interior'. Orchestrator output: 'The U.S. Department of State - Office of the Historian confirms that the U.S. Congress approved the Compact of Free Association relating to the Marshall Islands and Micronesia in 1986.'
